we present a novel approach for multivariate time series forecasting, called Spacetimeformer.
Spacetimeformer can: (a) outperform state of the art models in multivariate forecasting tasks with a large number of variables and (b) learn spatial and temporal interactions purely from data.

Spacetimeformer can: 1) learn spatiotemporal relationships purely from data, without the need for predefined spatial relationships, 2) scale to high-dimensional forecasting problems that are dominated by Graph Neural Network models, and 3) achieve competitive results on traffic, electricity demand, and weather prediction benchmarks.
